english.title: In the course of business supply / offer to supply apparatus in contravention of order under s. 72 - wireless telegraphy
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to section 74(1) and (4) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 74(2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 provides that a person is to be treated as offering to supply apparatus if -
(a) he exposes apparatus for supply, or
(b) he has apparatus in his possession for supply.
(ii) Section 75 of the Act provides for cases where the commission of this offence by one person is due to the act or default of another person.
(iii) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(iv) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.
(v) The Wireless Telegraphy (Fixed Penalty) Regulations 2011, (In force 01/10/2011), introduces a £100-00p fixed penalty charge for summary only offences under the Act, as from that date. This regime does not include offences relating to illegal broadcasting (pirate radio).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
